title: Application progress and clinical translation of artificial intelligence-assisted endoscopic diagnosis of early esophageal squamous cell carcinoma

contributions.purpose: 综述 AI 在早期 ESCC 病灶检测中的进展(WLI/NBI/多模态/实时)
contributions.mechanism: 汇总 DCNN/ResNeXt/HRNet/YOLO 等检测模型在单模态与多模态内镜的文献
contributions.evaluation: 引用他人数字:WLI 检测敏感度 89.5-97.8%、准确率 84.5-91.4%;多模态系统敏感度 92.5-99.7%;辅助后非专家准确率 78.3%→88.2%
contributions.domain: AI 辅助内镜早癌检测(消化道肿瘤)
contributions.source_quote: These studies have jointly verified the core advantages of AI models in detecting ESCC under WLI: the sensitivity (89.5%-97.8%) and accuracy (84.5%-91.4%) consistently surpass those of non-expert physicians

contributions.purpose: 综述 AI 在病灶边界勾画中的进展
contributions.mechanism: 汇总基于 YOLACT/YOLACT++ 实例分割的多中心边界勾画研究
contributions.evaluation: 引用他人数字:检测敏感度 96.5%、勾画准确率 88.9%、平均 IoU 75.9%;前瞻实时诊断准确率 91.4%,速度 12ms/图 vs 医师 21.4-33.6s/图
contributions.source_quote: it showed a real-time diagnostic accuracy of 91.4% and a depiction accuracy of 85.9%, which was much faster than that of human physicians (12ms/image vs 21.4-33.6 seconds/image)

contributions.purpose: 综述 AI 在浸润深度预测与 IPCL 微血管分型中的进展
contributions.mechanism: 汇总 HRNet/CNN 对 EP-SM1 vs SM2/SM3 分层及 JES 分型(A/B1/B2/B3)研究
contributions.evaluation: 引用他人数字:深浸润预测总体准确率 80.7%、SM2/SM3 敏感度 89%、特异度 95%;IPCL 分型内/外部验证准确率 91.3%/89.8%
contributions.domain: 同上(浸润深度/微血管分型)
contributions.source_quote: the comprehensive accuracy of IPCL classification in the internal validation set and the external validation set reached 91.3% and 89.8%, respectively

contributions.purpose: 识别临床转化瓶颈与未来方向
contributions.mechanism: 定性归纳当前研究局限(样本量小、单中心、缺前瞻/多模态/视频验证)与伦理风险
contributions.evaluation: 定性(无原创数字):指出样本量不足、单中心回顾性数据泛化性差、缺多模态集成与前瞻验证、过度依赖 AI 的伦理隐患
contributions.source_quote: First, most current AI-assisted diagnosis studies suffer from insufficient sample sizes. Most studies are trained on single-center, retrospective datasets... Future efforts will require integrating resources from major medical institutions, establishing standardized, large-scale datasets

notes: 综述类论文(application progress/clinical translation),无任何原创实验,协议四元组套不上:mechanism 实为对他人模型的文献汇总,evaluation 全部是综述中引用的他人研究数字(WLI/NBI/多模态检测、边界勾画、浸润深度、IPCL 分型),非本文实测;C4 为定性归纳无数字。无编号贡献列表,4 条由 abstract+全文结构归纳。self_declared_provenance 为空:全文未出现 extend/adapt/replace/build on X 式的方法沿承声明。CHECKLIST 重大 AI 自我披露:全文由研究团队自研工具 "Lunjie" AI 生成(Q1 Hypothesis=A 研究者提出但用 AI 综述;Q2 Experimental design=A;Q3 Analysis=D;Q4 Writing=C——正文 AI 生成、摘要因不满意由 AI 按正文重生成、原文为简体中文经 Google Translate 译成英文);自承 AI 局限:参考文献须 <50 篇否则质量下降、引用可能不完整、重复生成结果差异大、存在 hallucination 需人工核验、模型不支持英文输出。补充材料明确 "This study used AI to write the first draft" 并列出文献筛选/数量适配/内容真实性三大假设及其被打破的链式风险。负结果/trade-off:文中提到 B2 型血管医师准确率仅 63.6-67%、SM1 病灶 AI 准确率仅 67.8%(易受壁外压迫伪影误判)、放大视频运动模糊致 NBI 单帧敏感度 60.8% vs 96.1%,均为引用数字。
